MagicCocktail.NAME: Magic Cocktail
DESCRIPTIONS: At the start of each combat, add a #yBed #yOf #yMagic to your hand.

HiddenMagicCocktail.NAME: Hidden Magic Cocktail
DESCRIPTIONS: Replaces #rMagic #rCocktail. At the start of each combat, add a #yBed #yOf #yMagic+ to your hand.

BedOfChaos.NAME: Bed Of Chaos
BedOfChaos.FLAVOR: A seedbed born from magic mixed beyond control.
DESCRIPTIONS: Replaces #rMagic #rCocktail. At the start of each turn, gain a #yBed #yOf #yMagic effect for a random number of Attack and Skill cards.

BequestOfSeath.NAME: Bequest Of Seath
BequestOfSeath.FLAVOR: A cold, pale inheritance from a blind seeker of immortality.
DESCRIPTIONS: The first time you play a Magic card each turn, gain [E] .

ScrollOfLogan.NAME: Scroll Of Logan
ScrollOfLogan.FLAVOR: A scroll left by Big Hat Logan's tireless study.
DESCRIPTIONS: At the start of your turn, add a random Crystal card to your hand.

OolacileIvoryCatalyst.NAME: Oolacile Ivory Catalyst
OolacileIvoryCatalyst.FLAVOR: An ivory branch once used to weave old light into sorcery.
DESCRIPTIONS: Whenever you play *Bed *Of *Magic, gain 6 Block and draw 1 card.

SixthSense.NAME: Sixth Sense
DESCRIPTIONS: Every 2 Skill cards played, gain 6 Block.

HonorOfPinionfolk.NAME: Honor Of Pinionfolk
DESCRIPTIONS: At the start of each combat, gain 2 #yHover.

Marking.NAME: Marking
DESCRIPTIONS: Every 2 Skill cards played, gain 6 Block.

FighterResolve.NAME: Fighter Resolve
DESCRIPTIONS: At the start of each combat, gain #yUnyielding.

BorrowedLife.NAME: Borrowed Life
BorrowedLife.FLAVOR: A victory claimed before the debt is paid.
DESCRIPTIONS: #yGrey #yHealth and #yGrey #yHealth+ do not cause HP loss at the end of combat.

DebtToBond.NAME: Debt To Bond
DESCRIPTIONS: At the start of your turn, if you have #yGrey #yHealth or #yGrey #yHealth+, gain [E] .

FighterDestined.NAME: Fighter Destined
FighterDestined.FLAVOR: Replaces Fighter Resolve. Victory is decided before the wound is paid.
DESCRIPTIONS: Replaces #rFighter #rResolve. At the start of each combat, gain #yUnyielding+.

Restage.NAME: Restage
DESCRIPTIONS: Every 2 Skill cards played, gain 6 Block.

Suncatcher.NAME: Suncatcher
DESCRIPTIONS: Every 2 Skill cards played, gain 6 Block.

SummonSpirit.NAME: Summon Spirit
DESCRIPTIONS: At the start of your first 3 turns, summon Summon: Helen, Summon: Frederick, and Summon: Sebastian in order.

Bagcraft.NAME: Bagcraft
DESCRIPTIONS: Gain #b3 Potion slots containing random potions.

Trance.NAME: Trance
DESCRIPTIONS: Every 2 Skill cards played, gain 6 Block.
